name: Gift of Tempered Blade
description: After obtaining "Mortenax Blade" from the Character Event Warp, you can receive a brand-new Trailblaze Outfit piece.
introduction:
◆ Event Details ◆
During the Version 4.3 "Now I Am Become Blade" Character Event Warp, obtain "Mortenax Blade" through the Character Event Warp to receive the new back accessory Trailblaze Outfit "Karmic Fire of the Distant Shore."
● After obtaining the Trailblaze Fashion outfit "Karmic Fire of the Distant Shore," you can view and equip it via the Character — Outfits interface.
● Trailblaze Fashion will be hidden in certain mission performances and cutscenes.
